product_metadata.title: Joseph Joseph Chop2Pot Cutting Board, Small, Green
features: Award-winning folding chopping board, available in a variety of sizes and colours
Provides a durable, knife-friendly cutting surface
When the handle is squeezed, the sides of the board fold up forming a chute down which chopped food or waste can be neatly guided
Comfortable soft-grip handle and non-slip feet
description: Chop2Pot is Joseph Joseph's original, award-winning folding cutting board. Laid flat, it provides a durable, knife-friendly cutting surface for all types of food preparation. But when the handle is squeezed, the sides of the board fold up, forming a convenient chute down which chopped food or waste can be neatly guided.
